basic_details.job_title: Zilla Parishad Amravati Law Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Zilla Parishad Amravati (जिल्हा परिषद अमरावती), Maharashtra, needs one Law Officer (Contractual) (विधी अधिकारी (कंत्राटी)) on a purely contractual basis for 11 months, at a consolidated monthly honorarium of Rs. 54,000. Law graduates holding a Sanad with at least 7 years of advocacy practice must send or hand in the application to the General Administration Department, Zilla Parishad, Amravati, so that it reaches by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026; applications received later will not be considered.

qualification.details: There is one post, Law Officer (Contractual), with a consolidated admissible monthly honorarium of Rs. 54,000/-. The notice sets these eligibility conditions: | The candidate should be a law graduate of a recognised university and should hold a Sanad. A minimum of 7 years of experience in advocacy practice is required. Knowledge is required of the Maharashtra Zilla Parishads and Panchayat Samitis Act, 1961, The Maharashtra Recognition of Trade Unions and Prevention of Unfair Labour Practices Act, 1971, the Bombay Village Panchayats Act, 1958, the Zilla Parishad service rules, the Maharashtra Civil Services Rules, the departmental enquiry rules and other related laws. The candidate should have full knowledge of Marathi, Hindi and English. Age: not more than 50 years at the time of appointment. Preference in the interview will be given to candidates who have worked as a Law Officer in a government or semi-government office. | No allowances other than the approved honorarium will be admissible. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: Candidates will be selected through an interview. The final authority for selection rests with a selection committee chaired by the Chief Executive Officer
Amravati. Experience as a Law Officer in a government or semi-government office will get preference in the interview. No travel expenses will be paid for attending the interview.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely contractual, for only 11 months; the person appointed will not be treated as a government officer or employee. The contract is first made for 11 months and ends when the 11 months are over. If the work as Law Officer is found satisfactory, the Chief Executive Officer has the authority to extend it for a further 11 months. During the contract, the candidate cannot continue any private practice or work related to advocacy; if found doing so, the appointment will be cancelled. The selected candidate must sign the prescribed agreement with the office; only then will the appointment order be issued. Attendance in office from 10 AM to 6 PM, and after office hours when required, is compulsory. The Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Parishad, Amravati, reserves all rights to change the terms and conditions partly or fully and to cancel the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format, which is available for download on the Zilla Parishad website www.zpamravati.gov.in . The completed application, with the necessary documents, goes to this office, in person or by post: General Administration Department, Zilla Parishad, Amravati (letterhead address: Camp Parisar, Amravati 444602) Download the application form from www.zpamravati.gov.in . Fill in the form completely. Attach one colour photograph of yourself and the necessary documents. Write "कंत्राटी विधी अधिकारी पदभरती अर्ज" (Contractual Law Officer Recruitment Application) clearly on the envelope. Hand it in at the General Administration Department during office hours or send it by post so that it reaches by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026. The office can be contacted on 0721 2662932 or at [email protected] . The notice does not mention applying by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post, Law Officer (Contractual), with a consolidated admissible monthly honorarium of Rs. 54,000/-. The notice sets these eligibility conditions: The candidate should be a law graduate of a recognised university and should hold a Sanad. A minimum of 7 years of experience in advocacy practice is required. Knowledge is required of the Maharashtra Zilla Parishads and Panchayat Samitis Act, 1961, The Maharashtra Recognition of Trade Unions and Prevention of Unfair Labour Practices Act, 1971, the Bombay Village Panchayats Act, 1958, the Zilla Parishad service rules, the Maharashtra Civil Services Rules, the departmental enquiry rules and other related laws. The candidate should have full knowledge of Marathi, Hindi and English. Age: not more than 50 years at the time of appointment. Preference in the interview will be given to candidates who have worked as a Law Officer in a government or semi-government office. No allowances other than the approved honorarium will be admissible. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: ZP Amravati Law Officer (Contractual) Job Description
content_sections.text: Advise on all legal and court matters received by the office and handle court cases. Examine the written statements and affidavits received from advocates on the Zilla Parishad panel on service, administrative and departmental enquiry matters, and the current position of law, and obtain the Chief Executive Officer's signature on them. Follow up pending court cases for quick disposal, and prepare, with the help of the officers concerned, the affidavits to be filed where the government is a respondent. Draft affidavits, get them approved by the competent authority and ensure they are filed in court within the prescribed time. Study court judgments given against the Zilla Parishad and take action on filing appeals in consultation with the Chief Executive Officer. Where an appeal is proper, draft it, take further action with the competent authority's approval and follow up until the final decision. Work as the nodal officer at Zilla Parishad level for all court cases. Complete legal work assigned from time to time within the set time. Complete the legal work entrusted by the Chief Executive Officer from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ZP Amravati Law Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Law Officer (Contractual) at Zilla Parishad Amravati.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ZP Amravati Law Officer post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the General Administration Department, Zilla Parishad, Amravati, by 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026; applications received later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the ZP Amravati Law Officer post?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a law graduate of a recognised university holding a Sanad, with at least 7 years of advocacy practice and knowledge of the Acts and service rules listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ZP Amravati Law Officer post?
faq.answer: The candidate's age should not be more than 50 years at the time of appointment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ZP Amravati Law Officer (Contractual)?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated admissible monthly honorarium of Rs. 54,000/-, and no other allowances are admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the ZP Amravati Law Officer post?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.zpamravati.gov.in and submit it with the necessary documents and one colour photograph, in person or by post, to the General Administration Department, Zilla Parishad, Amravati.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must clearly carry the words "कंत्राटी विधी अधिकारी पदभरती अर्ज" (Contractual Law Officer Recruitment Application).

faq.question: Q8. How will the ZP Amravati Law Officer be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview, with final authority resting with a selection committee chaired by the Chief Executive Officer; experience as a Law Officer in a government or semi-government office gets preference.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ZP Amravati Law Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely contractual for 11 months, and the Chief Executive Officer may extend it for a further 11 months if the work is satisfactory.

faq.question: Q10. Can the Law Officer continue private legal practice?
faq.answer: No, private practice or work related to advocacy is not allowed during the contract, and the appointment will be cancelled if it is found.
